summary: Nektar Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $150 million of common stock via Guggenheim Securities and H.C. Wainwright. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices (last sale $85.09 on May 6, 2026) with a 3.0% commission. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not an event-driven special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; no board recommendation, premium, or structural special-situation elements are present.
